Below Expectations
Sep 2026 • Solo
My expectations were high due to its high ratings. Unfortunately, my experience was below expectations. The restaurant is nicely tucked in a corner of a busy street of the Old Quarter. 

Food : I ordered the Nem Lui and Nem Hanoi Combo Noodle Platter and also Green Mango Salad with Shrimp. My Platter came out first instead of the salad. The Nem Lui was dry and cold. Tasted like it was pre made and just reheated. My server was nice enough to prepare my BBQ Pork and explained how to eat it. The Manago Salad came out when I was already halfway finished with my platter. The disappointment continues since the Mango is not crunchy at all, it was already soft and also not cold. It was also bland.

Service: I do hate to see servers on their phones, looking down staring at it. That another negative for me. 

Price : Prices also on the highy side. The restaurant ambiance is good. I do love the decor with a combination of modern and artsy.

Overall experience was below expectations. I do not recommend the restaurant.

Good food and excellent service. Stick with Vietnamese food.
Dec 2025 • Family
I'd go back here. The menu offers a few western dishes but stick with the Vietnamese traditional food and you won't go wrong. Entrees were seasoned properly and presentation was quite appetizing. You can skip some of the $$$$ places and get much better food here. A couple of things to note: 1) the food portion is quite small. If you are accustomed to eating Denny's breakfast menu from one of the flyover states, please order two portions for one person; 2) the reservation fills up quite quickly. You should show up on time or you can lose your table.

An evening in Hanoi
Apr 2025 • Couples
The Tet restaurant is a sweet bubble after a day of sightseeing in Hanoi. We push the door to enter into the calm: dim light, an air of Jazz and the welcome of Lisa all softly and kindly. We ate tasty dishes and were offered a herbal tea to finish the meal. 
A few words in English, French and a chin in Vietnamese and here we are back in the bustle of Hanoi, the city that never sleeps. Thank you for this timeless break that has resourced us!
